description: Ghana - National Daily Peak Demand for Electricity is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy demand, Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Ghana Grid Company (GRIDCo) (World Bank Group). National Daily Peak Demand for Electricity in Ghana for years 2009 and 2010. Citation: Ghana Grid Company (GRIDCo) & Negawatt challenge. A curated list of datasets for the World Bank Negawatt Challenge competition in Accra and Nairobi cities:. Coverage: Ghana. It has 2 files in CSV. The portal files it under Energy demand, Power system and utilities. The portal gives 2009 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
